correctness.rationale: The four-species matrix C_a at epsilon=(a²−a+1)/a³ has rank three, right null q=(-1/a,1/a²,-1/a³,1), left null ℓ=(-1,a,−a²,a²−a+1), and ℓ·1=0. Hence H=ℓ·log x is exactly conserved. Independent exact symbolic work verifies Dq=ℓ for D=diag(a,a³,a⁵,a²−a+1), symmetric S=(DC+CᵀD)/2 has Sq=0 and its first three leading minors are a, 3a⁴/4, −a¹⁰(a²−a+1)(a³−a²+a−3)/4. These are positive for 1<a<rho, making ker S exactly span(q); positive relative entropy sublevels are compact in positive orthant, LaSalle implies convergence to equilibrium line, and H is strictly monotone along line and diverges at endpoints, determining a unique limit. Transverse coercivity on the conserved level gives exponential convergence. Any positive diagonal PSD scaling must satisfy Dq∝ℓ, proving uniqueness and sharp certificate iff a≤rho. The cutoff is for this certificate, not for dynamical instability; no claim of convergence at a=rho.
